notes.title: Nour 1.2.1! Spawn cap changes 🔥
notes.content:
Since Nour is out on Nintendo Switch we're bringing in some optimizations to the game experience! 

Meta Spawn Cap: The spawn cap for physics objects is now shared across all items and scales based on platform tier. A slider option has been added for PC players to adjust the spawn cap. 

[h2]General Fixes[/h2]
Addressed various issues, including tool movement bugs in the burger scene, fixed noodle creation in the meat grinder, and corrected audio instance limits.
[h2]Popcorn level Fixes[/h2]
Resolved issues with de-spawned food not replenishing and frozen kernels not responding to inputs. Jellyfish no longer collide with problematic stage objects in the Popcorn level.
[h3]Level Unlocks[/h3]
Fixed an issue where levels were not unlocking correctly after progression.
Vibration and Rumble Adjustments: Adjusted rumble intensity and fixed issues with vibration on multiple platforms.
Collider Fixes: Adjusted ground mesh colliders in the Toaster level to improve performance and fixed the egg shatter threshold.

I'm still tryna add fun stuff in future updates too, lemme know if there's any foods you're dyin to see in Nour 🍨🍜🍥

notes.title: Nour 1.1
notes.content:
We don't like bugs in our food so we squished some of them. Here's some of the ones we squished: 

[list]
[*] Mic feature scaling adjustments 
[*] Tutorial failsafes
[*] Fixed a bug preventing some liquids from rendering
[*] Fixed a few missing translations
[/list]

[b][u]Quality of life:[/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Right analog stick can move spawners 
[*] Blowtorch is more responsive
[*] Tools ignore invisible walls that would otherwise obstruct them
[*] Game's framerate is limited to keep it from making everyone's GPU's way too hot. We ain't tryina cook an egg on your nvidia geforce.
[/list]

[b][u]New![/u][/b]
[list]
[*] Move Tool! Use R2 or Mouse1 to pick up and move foods
[*] Achievements! 
[/list]

After a lot of wrestling with tech, achievements have been added in! Apologies for the wait. 

KickStarter backers have been added to credits as well. Sorry they were missing for so long! They were meant to go in before our launch date, but we dropped the ball on prioritizing them above other technical issues that were coming up. We put a lil secret in the game for y'all that we'll outline how to reach in a KS email :) 

-tj

notes.title: Nour is ready to serve on September 12!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38616065/762e02a0ecbfa49b5168af69c7068644b77f713a.png[/img]

Heya foodies, 

The time has come. Nour: Play With Your Food is release on September 12! And we have a little trailer as a treat featuring an original song by the incredible Tobi Lou.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Zjxr5Q6eLIE 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38616065/48b8144abeb8cda9323704c80c2b155cef06f61c.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/38616065/0a933df5ddd3c1aaa0f9849dd1c75e0ad7bc1f8b.gif[/img]

Nour is unconventional and wild, and it was a joy to make. We set out to make a game with no goals or objectives other than experiencing the joy of freely interacting with the highly detailed virtual representations of delicious food and snacks we enjoy every day. Now we’re almost done, and if you think that idea for a game sounds fun, we hope you give Nour a shot when it releases in a couple weeks.

Go give it a wishlist if you haven't yet! 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141050/Nour_Play_with_Your_Food/

notes.title: I'm really looking forward to tucking into Nour: Play With Your Food later this year
notes.content:
"Olivia, get the bowls and chopsticks ready to eat dinner," my mum asks 10 year old me. I do as I'm told, taking them to the dinner table. In childish, whimsical fashion as a childish, whimsical child, I grab my pair of chopsticks and start hitting them together as if I'm a drummer. "Olivia, don't do that," my mum scolds me. "Your grandma always used to tell me off when I did that as a child." Sullenly, I put the chopsticks back down on the table.

Well, 10 year old me, you're in for a treat. If you wait a couple of decades, you'll learn of Nour: Play With Your Food, a game which allows you to bang together chopsticks. The game wants you to. Nour is a physics simulation of a variety of foods, where you can choose the ingredients for the dish and add various "effects" of a non-culinary nature.

notes.title: Play the Nour demo now!
notes.content:
Hiya food folks!

Let’s get the big news outta the way… 

Yes, a demo for Nour is out now! It is real! You can play it! 😲

If you’ve followed our game here for a while, you know it has been a long and twisty road. Turns out there is no exact recipe for making a video game, especially not one about wildly interactive food. 

With our demo out now into the world, I wanted to let you know that we'll have more news soon about when the game will be coming out! This game required a lot of help in the kitchen to make sure it was done just right, so much so that we even got the fine folks at Serenity Forge to help out with development this past year. They made sure our Game Stew was seasoned just right.

For now I’ll let you dive into the demo, which highlights the first few levels of the final game, and we will be back once we have our final release date. Talk soon and please leave us a wishlist on your way out!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1141050/Nour_Play_with_Your_Food/

peace , TJ ✌️
